newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Victorias unit seeks help on loan troubles.
newsitem.headline: Victorias unit seeks help on loan troubles.

text.p: Financially-troubled North Negros Marketing Co Inc, the trading arm of sugar miller Victorias Milling Corp, asked the government on Monday to help in its rehabilitation.

"Should the rehabilitation of the company be no longer possible, petitioner prays for the dissolution of the company and liquidation of its assets to answer for its liabilities," the firm said in its petition gor a debt moratorium to the Philippine Securities and Exchange Commission.
The firm had asked the SEC to shield it from its creditors while it was undergoing rehabilitation.

It had sufficient receivables and assets to cover its debts but timely repayments may not be possible because of difficulties in the collection of receivables and in liquidating assets, the company said.
North Negros said it has total liabilities of 2.196 billion pesos as of March 31 against total assets of 2.106 billion.
The firm blamed the slump in the Philippine sugar industry for its woes.
North Negros' parent Victorias has also sought a moratorium on the principal payment of its 4.423 billion pesos debt from 32 local and foreign creditors.
